text:
ana: Quick standup  T-72h to marketplace public launch. Need final owners for press kit, marketplace tiles, and partner onboarding window. Short replies.

vik: I can take marketplace tiles & staging -> prod cutover. Will run visual diffs.

kelly: I'll own press kit + blog coordination. What's our embargo time?

ana: Putting embargo at 2026-06-02T18:00Z. Kelly please confirm press contacts and asset drop timing.

press-bot: Embargo set: 2026-06-02T18:00Z. Reminders scheduled at T-24h and T-2h.

kelly: Press contacts: media@redwood.com, partners-press@leeco.com, Orbit agency. Asset drop scheduled 2026-06-02T16:00Z to allow translations. Need legal to confirm quote usage.

partner-lee: Lee (partner): sending final logo set and short partner bio. CSM will join +3h onboarding window.

tom: Quick ops checklist snippet:
```
- Offer IDs provisioned for AWS/GCP/AZ
- Billing smoke (purchase + cancel)
- Provisioning webhook verified (retries tested)
- Landing page slug ready with geo-tiles
- Support rota + escalation matrix in place
```

vik: Staging rehearsal tomorrow 08:30 PT. I'll invite partner lead and QA. Need someone to validate billing smoke.

ana: Vik, @tom will validate billing. Tom pls confirm SKU->plan parity.

tom: Confirmed  SKU parity validated in catalog-config v3.4. I pushed checksum and alerted billing.

kelly: Legal signoff?

press-bot: Legal-bot: Quote approved; logo usage cleared for hero and footer. No extra redlines.

ana: Contingency plan: If AWS listing approval delayed, we'll publish a "Listing coming soon" tile with email capture and schedule a follow-up announcement when listing goes live. Vik pls prepare fallback tile.

vik: Will prepare fallback tile and mobile variant. Also will stage feature flag marketplace_public to toggle.

ana: Metrics to monitor on go-live: impressions, CTA clicks, provisioning success rate, and first-hour trial activations. Tom, can you add those to the dashboard and set an alert for provisioning failures >4%?

tom: On it  dashboard tiles added, slack alert channel = #marketplace-ops, threshold 4% in first 15m.

ana: Owners recap: Vik=tiles & cutover; Kelly=press & assets; Tom=billing + dashboard; Partner-lee=assets + CSM. React with :white_check_mark: when green.

partner-lee: :white_check_mark: assets pushed. CSM confirmed.

vik: :white_check_mark: staging invite sent; fallback tile ready.

kelly: :white_check_mark: press kit queued; translations in flight.

tom: :white_check_mark: billing smoke scheduled 07:45 PT tomorrow.

ana: Thanks all  final dry-run 08:30 PT tomorrow. I'll DM any last-minute notes.

press-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run at 2026-05-30T15:30Z.
